notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 New 2 step Weapon Reloading
notes.content:
Patch 1.1.0 

The [b]Oculus Quest link[/b] cable has been fixed. The menu and grip buttons were not working when you play the game. Thank you to [b]Joe and Friedya[/b] from the [b]community[/b] for helping us find and fix that issue.


[list]
[*] New two step reloading mechanics for machine guns and hand weapons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34947168/7b3dd0206dbe96c56ce5ac1dd756f51fc35a989e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Changes for reloading have been made to create more immersion and reward aim accuracy. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] A red dot sight has been added to the StG 44 in later levels to improve the ability to get headshots on the tougher enemy types.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Bazooka damage has also been increased to vehicles and infantry.
[/list] 
[list]
[*] A new weapon, the VG1-5 has been added to the last stage of the Tank Commander Mode. This is a late war German assault rifle made as a cheaper version of the StG44. VG1-5 stands as the faster firing, more rugged version of the StG44.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34947168/76e3daef9dc816ea36aa7aed91265201efd2ce34.png[/img]


[list]
[*] Checkpoints have been added to some of the longer stationary encounters.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Improvements to certain UI elements and game encounters.
[/list]



Thanks for playing.
Best
10th Reality

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
1.0.9 has some additional physics hot fixes and a few FX improvements.

-Fixed a physics issue where the player tank does not register the ground correctly
-Some FX improvements made to enemy vehicle destruction animations

Respectfully,
Gabriel

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
1.0.8 has some bug hotfixes, usability pass, and FX improvements.

-Fixed a physics issue that was messing with the players ability to grab things
-Fixed the sniper scope not always rendering when equipped.
-Adjusted the size of the turret 30cal projectile to make it easier to use.
-All buildings in Commander Mode are now destructible.

Respectfully,
Gabriel

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Based on feedback and testing some minor changes have been made to the game to make things more clear and improve the players experience.
[list]
[*] Changed the the 30cal turret tracers to be more visible
[*] Adjusted particles to make it more clear when you can use the fire extinguisher
[*] Adjust some encounters and tank mechanics based on player feedback
[*] Adjusted the tank commander mode and starting barn tutorial to instruct the player better
[*] Various main menu and UI updates
[/list]
Respectfully,
Gabriel

notes.title: Winter Fury: The Longest Road 1.0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34947168/316b8945525159b22dfa1ba0280ba83c93322664.jpg[/img]

Fight formidable foes with new enemy types across the countryside and through war-torn cityscapes. Witness the wake of the devastation left by the M-4’s arsenal with satisfyingly destructive firepower. Encounter colossal bosses including a King Tiger tank, Bf 109 fighter plane, and even a coastal destroyer ship. Triumph over each mounting threat the German forces deploy.

With [b]update 1.0.6[/b] we have fully added into the Arcade missions the fun of fighting through the German lines from the cockpit of a tank. The turret controls, 30Cal, and 75 mm cannon are now in the Arcade missions along with some new enemy types. In addition, a fire extinguisher has been added to the tank that can be used to restore vitally needed health in tight situations.
[list]
[*] Tank cockpit controls have been added into the arcade missions.
[*] Added in a fire extinguisher to the tank that can heal the player when low on health.
[*] More destructible props added into the Arcade mode.
[*] Added a holographic sight for aiming when inside the cockpit.
[*] Grease Gun added as the default weapon in the Tank Commander Mode.
[*] Workaround for the SteamVR update that broke the level transition screen faders.
[*] Improvements to some models and textures inside the tank cockpit.
[*] Improved rope dropping and repel animations on bridge rope enemies.
[*] Updates to the player hand animations.
[*] Various art improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]
Thank you for the continued support of Winter Fury: The Longest Road. If you have any technical issues or have feedback about the game leave it on our [url=https://discord.gg/wdqD9aM]Discord[/url].

Respectfully,
Gabriel

notes.title: Winter Fury: The Longest Road 1.0.4
notes.content:
Thank you for the support and feedback we have gotten since Winter Fury's release in December. With the start of the new year we are improving many of the player experience issues mentioned as well improving the core mechanics of the game. This update is part of a series of improvements we are working on for both the Tank Commander and Arcade mode.

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] New models, animations, and shaders for the player hands and bandages
[*] Added a progressive damage state shader for the player hands
[*] Tracking on the player hands have been improved to better respond when tracking is obscured or lost
[*] When you let go of weapons they now blend back into position
[*] Descriptions have been added to the menu to better clarify what is included in the two game modes
[*] Fixed certain looping German audio that did shut off correctly
[*] Fixed some encounters with enemy units that appear out of thin air
[*] Vehicles shells in the Arcade mode have been better balanced to account for the different weapon types
[*] Various encounter and gameplay fixes throughout the Arcade mode
[*] An additional destructible buildings has been added into the Tank Commander mode
[/list]

See our [url=https://discord.gg/wdqD9aM]Discord[/url] for more information about upcoming features or if you have any issues surrounding the game.

Additionally, there is also a fix for players whose save data was overwritten by an update.  Future updates will no longer affect save data and the game should restore you to the save file with the most progress unlocked. However, if this update does not restore the save file you desired you can also manually force it to update by following the steps below.

1. Go to your save folder location for Winter Fury: The Longest Road. Usually under C:\Users\USER_NAME\AppData\LocalLow\SpiderMonk
2. Copy the "SpiderMonK” folder and paste it to your desktop as a backup.
3. Go inside the "SpiderMonk" folder to see your save data folders.
4. Delete the "LongestRoad" folder out of the "SpiderMonk" folder
5. Launch Winter Fury: The Longest Road from Steam.

This will restore your save file to the one with the most progress unlocked. For additional help please contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/wdqD9aM]Discord[/url] for further assistance.

Thank you for the continued support. We have many plans for Winter Fury: The Longest Road and would love to hear your feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/wdqD9aM]Discord[/url].

Respectfully,
Gabriel

notes.title: Winter Fury: The Longest Road 1.0.0
notes.content:
In the 1.0.0 update Winter Fury: The Longest Road gets more enemies, more levels, and a new game mode. The Tank Commander Mode allows players to drive their M4 Sherman tank into battle fighting German forces for control of the area. Expect to see new enemies and random encounters as you progress through the stages of increasingly difficult enemies.

The final Arcade mission has also been added. Featuring a dense village level to showcase intense close quarters urban combat.

After Months of work, we are happy to present the new Tank Commander Mode as well as the completion of the last Arcade mission. Support and updates to the game are planned for the future.

Please join us on our Discord if you need support or want to talk about the game:
https://discord.gg/wdqD9aM

notes.title: Update 0.9.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34947168/0d3e961f0a7c541a0c004df9ef73f2db4049b6ac.png[/img]
Some new weapons have been added and the AI systems have been overhauled in preparation for the Tank Battle Mode.
[list]
[*] Webley pistol: A power revolver that can take out many enemies with one head shot.
[*] PPSH41: A fast rate of fire SMG with a large drum magazine. 
[*] StG44: A powerful assault rifle capable of reliable sustained damage.
[*] Fire sounds have been improved on all the weapons in the game.
[*] Existing weapons have been adjusted to make every weapon more unique.
[*] Added recoil when zoomed into the scope to make shots feel more impactful.
[*] Adjusted the grenade mechanics to be more user-friendly.
[*] Added in more behaviors for the enemy AI within the arcade mode.
[*] Various bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Going to PAX West!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947168/f62959a22cd00de4b1a59429eaa4bd9d011e4ee6.png[/img]
Winter Fury: The Longest Road is coming to [url=https://west.paxsite.com/news/article/the-pax-west-2019-exhibitor-list]PAX West[/url]. We are going to Seattle, Washington for PAX West on AUG 30 - SEP 2, 2019. At PAX, we are going to showcase upcoming features and the new game modes under development.

We have also started streaming development on twitch at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/spidermonkgames]Spidermonkgames[/url]. This week, during our live stream, we showcased some upcoming weapons and changes to the arcade mode. Including the powerful Webley revolver, the PPSH41 bullet hose, and the versatile StG44. Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SpiderMonkGames ]twitter[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/wdqD9aM ]discord[/url] server to be the first to catch updates.

notes.title: New Weapons & AI Being Improved
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947168/8bf6f3b4edd3fa8e63a4de101e6049eaa8a7b958.png[/img]
Thank you for the feedback everyone has given for the game's initial early access release. The next major milestone we are working on is a bundle of new weapons to use in the arcade mode of Winter Fury. This includes advanced german small arms and some classic allied firearms. 

In addition to this, the AI of the game is being overhauled to allow for more complex and reactive behaviour. To keep track of updates join our [url=https://discord.gg/dfpEhrf]discord [/url]where we will get into more detail  about development and long term roadmaps. Thank you again for the great feedback. We look forward to sharing with you some of the more exciting elements of Winter Fury that we are working on.
